build_generator_unet: build a pix2pix GeneratorUNet model with configurable input and output channels for image-to-image translation
build_discriminator: build a pix2pix Discriminator model that takes paired images and outputs real/fake predictions
create_unet_down_block: create a UNetDown downsampling block with optional instance normalization and dropout for the encoder
create_unet_up_block: create a UNetUp upsampling block with skip connection concatenation for the decoder
test_weights_init_normal: test the weights_init_normal function to initialize Conv and BatchNorm2d layer weights with normal distribution
